blurb: Guests can parasail using the latest technology on USCG-certified boats that exceed safety regulations. Jet ski rentals are available with no long waits and a small no wake zone for more riding time. Pontoon boat rentals provide easy access to Crab Island, just 2 minutes away.
extraNote: On-site customer parking covers one vehicle per booking, first come, first served · Extra cars park free at 310 Mountain Drive or $15 at 285 US-98 W · RVs and trailers use the paid public lot across the street · $3 NASBLA boater test available dockside · Destin X Watersports dock on Harbor Blvd (Highway 98) along the Destin Harbor
